dish: European-style beef curry — a deep brown roux of spices and fruit, with butter-topped potatoes
n: Curry Bondy, Jimbōchō (欧風カレー ボンディ)
w: Jimbōchō's curry institution, up a flight above a bookshop with lunchtime queues: first winner of the Kanda Curry Grand Prix (2011), known for a beef curry built on a deep brown roux of spices and fruit.
